question: A shopkeeper marks an article at such a price that after allowing a discount of 30% on the tag price he makes a profit of 40% . If the tag price of the article including tax is Tk. 460 . then the cost price of that article is--

question: In a certain office 1/3 of the workers are women , 1/2 of the women are married and 1/3 of the married women have children. If 3/4 of the men are married and 2/3 of the married men have children , what part of the workers have no children?
explanation:
🔖Let, Total worker = x
Women = x/3
Married women = 1/2 of x/3 = x/6
Married women how have children \( \left(\frac{1}{3}of\frac{x}{6}\right)=\frac{x}{18} \)
According to question,
Number of male of total worker 2x/3
Married male = 3/4 of 2x/3
= x/2
Married male who have children 2/3 of x/2= x/3
So, total number of worker with children x/3+x/18=6x+x/18=7x/18
Total worker without children x-7x/18=18x-7x/18=11x/18

question: The present age of Falcon is thrice the present age of Simran who is 20. How many years ago was the age of falcon five times that of Simaran?

question: Two years ago, Tim was three times as old as susie . Today he is twice as old as susie. How old is Tim today?
